long_biography.plain_text:
A printing-shop apprenticeship gave Roberto Irineu Marinho his first role inside Grupo Globo. He moved through reporting, publishing and television management before helping create the pay-television programmer Globosat and the online portal Globo.com. Those projects brought the family media group into subscription services and digital distribution.

At group level, Marinho introduced common management principles across Globo's businesses and led the launch of streaming service Globoplay. He stepped away from executive management in 2017 after fifteen years as president. Outside media, he developed the Sertaozinho farm complex in Minas Gerais and launched the Orfeu speciality-coffee brand in 2005.
